note: Recurring daily and weekly formats published by each Strip poker room whose official schedule document has been read: Wynn Las Vegas (daily poster and daily structures, read 2026-11-16), Bellagio (three weekly structure PDFs linked from its official poker page, read 2026-11-17) and Caesars Palace (its own 2026 daily NLH schedule PDF, read 2026-11-17). ARIA publishes no schedule on its official poker page, and the Venetian publishes only dated series pages, so neither contributes rows here. Every row carries its own source and retrieval date. None of the Bellagio or Caesars formats is single entry - each prints re-entry, flights or an add-on - so none is ranked; they are listed for the separate-section comparison only. Wynn: the official poker page states: "The Daily Tournament schedule will be suspended during each Wynn Signature, Wynn Millions, and Classic tournament series." The official daily terms and conditions state: "Registration for each Event will open four (4) hours prior to the scheduled start of play", so registration for the 12 p.m. daily events opens at 8 a.m. Note the suspension wording differs between the two official sources: the poker page names Wynn Signature, Wynn Millions and Classic series, while each daily structure sheet says the event "may be suspended during Seniors Events, Classic Events, or other Tournament Series". Neither names the WPT World Championship explicitly, so confirm before travelling. Read 2026-11-16.
